crossRefs.note: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it;
You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman, as to the weaker…
Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as…
For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off…
Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?
For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

translations.web: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”
translations.bsb: If they wish to inquire about something, they are to ask their own husbands at home; for it is dishonorable for a woman to speak in the church.
translations.kjv: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
translations.asv: And if they would learn anything, let them ask their own husbands at home: for it is shameful for a woman to speak in the church.
